<reason>Both sides conceded the switch must go and fought cleanly over which fixed clock to land on, which made the debate easy to follow. Side A's best material — the asymmetry between schedulable morning darkness and unschedulable evening life, and the collective-action defence of why a statutory shift succeeds where voluntary coordination fails — was genuinely strong and forced B into its thinnest reply (Spain/Germany as proof institutions can choose voluntarily). But Side B won the two most decisive moments. First, its pressure question demanded a number, and A's answer ("something like 8:30 is a defensible outer edge... Berlin, Warsaw, even Seattle sit close to that line") was an own-goal that B converted immediately: Berlin under permanent DST is nearer a quarter past nine, roughly an hour past A's self-declared limit, in the very cities A chose to defend. That exposed a real internal inconsistency rather than merely scoring a point. Second, B's framing — both clocks are mandates, but only one is a mandate you can live around, with flexibility left where it actually lives — reframed the comparison in a way that absorbed A's coordination argument without conceding the vote, and extended it to the nurse, bricklayer and drop-off parent who have no school board. B also kept the biological dose-dependence point ("light arriving during the first lesson versus after it") and the revealed-preference reading of the US and Russian reversals alive; A's dismissal of Russia as near-Arctic and 1974 as botched blunted but did not neutralise the pattern. B's clipped second rebuttal is a real execution cost, and A's closing weighing was crisp, but A never repaired the number it had volunteered, which left B holding the cleaner, self-consistent standard.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>Side B's pressure question forcing A to name an acceptable latest winter sunrise, followed by B's closing demonstration that Berlin and Warsaw under permanent DST fall roughly an hour past A's own stated 8:30 limit — turning A's concession into a self-defeating standard in the exact cities A had chosen.</best_rebuttal>
